display_label: HDFC Bank Limited — Enterprise Operations & Infrastructure

brand.executive_thesis: HDFC Bank's enterprise operations manage a vast physical footprint of thousands of branches and ATMs alongside massive data center infrastructure. The procurement and logistics backbone ensures secure cash transit, rapid IT hardware deployment, and seamless direct-to-customer distribution of debit and credit cards.
brand.flagship_sites: Mumbai Corporate Headquarters · Chandivali Data Center · Pan-India Currency Chests · Regional Processing Centers (RPCs) · Centralized Card Issuance Hubs
brand.erp_systems: Oracle ERP Cloud · SAP Ariba · Finacle (Core Banking) · Ivalua

custom_pillars.name: Network Strategy & Footprint Planning
custom_pillars.subtitle: Aligns business growth with physical branch expansion, ATM deployment, and data center capacity requirements.
custom_pillars.provenance_rationale: Post the HDFC Ltd. merger, HDFC Bank plans semi-urban and rural SmartBanking branch rollouts, ATM/Cash Recycler Machine (CRM) placement, and seasonal festive cash/card volume peaks across 4,000+ cities and towns.

Festive & harvest-season cash withdrawal and card issuance capacity planning

terminology_highlights: Currency Chest — Authorized branches that hold bulk cash on behalf of the RBI to supply ATMs and local branches.
RPC (Regional Processing Center) — Back-office hubs that handle document processing, clearing, and operational workflows.
Cash-in-Transit (CIT) — Secure logistics operations for moving physical currency between chests, branches, and ATMs.
ITAD (IT Asset Disposition) — Secure decommissioning and e-waste recycling of end-of-life servers, ATMs, and employee devices.
